aboutGame.title: What is Cronos Lazarus?
paragraphs: Cronos Lazarus is a story expansion for Cronos: The New Dawn developed by Bloober Team and PixelAnt Games. It returns players to the wastelands of New Dawn as the once-loyal Pathfinder, now transforming into the Warden, isolated in the Terminal and severed from the Collective as he tries to awaken a lost Essence.

The expansion replaces the base game's cautious, precision-first rhythm with faster, more aggressive combat. The Warden can leave decoys, turn temporarily invisible, and use enhanced traversal and Pathfinder technology while a relentless, adaptive hunter is sent to eliminate him. Cronos Lazarus launches December 3, 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, with a Nintendo Switch 2 release planned for the first quarter of 2027.

modules.name: Cronos Lazarus Gameplay Guide
modules.description: Learn how the expansion shifts from cautious survival horror to faster, more aggressive combat built around mobility and misdirection.

highlights.detail: Let the hunter commit to a pursuit before spending your decoy.
Deploy the decoy as you break line of sight and move to a new angle.
Use temporary invisibility to reposition laterally rather than retreating.
Chain enhanced traversal into the next attack instead of treating it as travel.
Rotate your tools so an adaptive enemy cannot lock onto one pattern.
End the fight before cooldowns run dry, then reset the arena for the next wave.

modules.name: Cronos Lazarus Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with the Pathfinder's transformation, the Terminal, and the combat habits that matter during your first hours as the Warden.

highlights.detail: Finish or revisit Cronos: The New Dawn so the Warden's history and the Collective's stakes are clear.
Confirm the base game is installed and free at least 30 GB before launch.
Practice decoy, cloak, and traversal as one chain instead of three panic buttons.
Keep moving against the hunter, rotate tactics, and save a cooldown for its later phases.

faq.title: Cronos Lazarus FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about Cronos Lazarus, the Warden's abilities, release details, and how the expansion connects to Cronos: The New Dawn.

items.question: What is Cronos Lazarus?
items.answer: Cronos Lazarus is a story expansion for Cronos: The New Dawn. You play the once-loyal Pathfinder as he transforms into the Warden, isolated in the Terminal and severed from the Collective.

items.question: When does Cronos Lazarus release?
items.answer: Cronos Lazarus launches on December 3, 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. A Nintendo Switch 2 version is planned for the first quarter of 2027.

items.question: Do I need Cronos: The New Dawn to play Cronos Lazarus?
items.answer: Yes. Cronos Lazarus is downloadable content and requires the base game. It continues the Warden's story directly, so finishing The New Dawn first gives the expansion's events their full context.

items.question: What abilities does the Warden use in Cronos Lazarus?
items.answer: The Warden can leave a decoy to misdirect enemies, become temporarily invisible, and use enhanced traversal. Pathfinder-reserved tools and a faster combat kit support those mobility and misdirection options.

items.question: Who is hunting the Warden in Cronos Lazarus?
items.answer: A new pursuer is engineered specifically to stop the Warden. It is relentless, highly adaptive, and strong enough to match him, with encounters that escalate into large-scale cinematic fights.

items.question: How does Cronos Lazarus change combat?
items.answer: Cronos Lazarus replaces the base game's cautious, precision-first rhythm with faster, more aggressive combat. Decoys, invisibility, and traversal are meant to be chained so the Warden controls distance and ends fights before the hunter adapts.
